data.title: Notice of Ending Support for Transactions (Ends September 30, 19) Monero(XMR), Dash(DASH), ZCASH(ZEC), Haven(XHV), BitTube(TUBE), PIVX(PIVX)
data.body:
Dear Upbit's Investors,

We are announcing the end of market trading support for XMR, DASH, ZEC, XHV, TUBE, PIVX.
These Crypto-Assets will cease trading support at 2019.09.30 11:00 within 10 days of publication on this bulletin, in accordance with the Upbit Crypto-Asset end of support policy.
**We do not support the deposit of these crypto-asset at this time, so please do not deposit.**

**[Common notes about ending trade support]**
- The end of trading support of crypto-asset is subject to the Upbit crypto-asset end of support policy.
:[Upbit crypto-asset end of support policy](https://upbit-sg-static.upbitit.sh/guide/post-listing_monitoring_en.pdf)
- These 6 Crypto-Assets will cease trading support at 2019.09.30 11:00 within 10 days of publication on this bulletin, in accordance with the Upbit Crypto-Asset end of support policy.
- At the end of transaction support, orders (buy / sell) requested before the end of the transaction support in KRW, BTC, ETH and USDT markets will be canceled

**[Reason for end of transaction support]**
- There are also crypto-assets that can selectively utilize anonymity features among projects that are subject to end of transaction support. For these crypto-assets, Upbit has only supported transparent withdrawal/deposit support.
- Nevertheless, the decision to end trading support for the crypto-asset was also made to block the possibility of money laundering and inflow from external networks. Upbit will continue to consider crypto-asset that represent anonymity functions as candidates for designation of investment warning crypto-asset.

**[End of Market Transaction Support by Crypto-Asset]**
1) Monero(XMR)
- Market : XMR/BTC, XMR/ETH, XMR/USDT
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)

2) DASH(DASH)
- Market : DASH/BTC, DASH/ETH, DASH/USDT
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)

3) ZCASH(ZEC)
- Market : ZEC/BTC, ZEC/ETH, ZEC/USDT
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)

4) Haven(XHV)
- Market : XHV/BTC
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)

5) Bitube(TUBE)
- Market : TUBE/BTC
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)

6) PIVX(PIVX)
- Market :  PIVX/BTC
- Expected end of support date/time : 2019.09.30 10:00 (SGT)
*At the end of transaction support, orders (buy / sell) requested before the end of the transaction support in KRW, BTC, ETH and USDT markets will be canceled
*Depositing these crypto-assets are not currently supported. Please never deposit these crypto-assets.
*Crypto-asset deposited after the end of the transaction support announcement will be reflected on Tuesday, 2019-10-01 after the end of the transaction support.
*Even if the support of the crypto-asset ends, it will support withdrawal for 30 days (~ 2019.10.19) from the end of the transaction support notification based on Article 18, Paragraph 5 of the Upbit Terms and Conditions.

Members who need to withdraw the crypto-asset must proceed withdrawal until 2019.10.19.
We will always do our best for your safe transaction.

Thank You.
